limits: Historical and BT23 scenario quantities intersect analyst caps; offered price converted to metric-tonne price floor plus assumed delivery for mapped crop groups, with separate soil/nutrient cost. No exact county curves, spatial dispatch, or observed future adoption. Wet waste model uses historical resource estimates, not current additional supply. No extra credits for FOG, digestate, existing digesters or wastewater avoided methane. Retained legacy V9.16 results are a distinct sensitivity.
